This page records cited recipe inputs, outputs, stations, and costs. Each entry describes one evidenced recipe variant; alternatives are not silently combined.

Station labels preserve the researched distinction, including a workstation, campfire, or alchemist workshop only where the entry supports it. A listed recipe does not establish that the player has unlocked it or can use it in every context.

Unknown additional costs and conditions remain marked as not established. Quantities are not inferred from item names or descriptions.
